title: School field-trip permission letter (Grade 4, Royal Ontario Museum)
source: synthetic (fictional school; written for this project)
notes: Danforth Park Public School and its staff are fictional. Exercises the drafter -> critic -> drafter revision loop in demo mode.
summary_en: A school letter about a Grade 4 trip on Thursday, October 15, 2026 costing $12.00; the signed permission form and payment are due to the teacher by Friday, October 9, 2026.
text:
Danforth Park Public School
41 Hillside Road, Toronto, Ontario
September 8, 2026

Dear Parent or Guardian,

Our Grade 4 classes will visit the Royal Ontario Museum on Thursday, October 15, 2026. Students will travel by school bus, leaving the school at 9:15 a.m. and returning by 2:30 p.m.

The cost of the trip is $12.00 per student, which covers admission and the bus. Please return the permission form below, with payment, to your child's teacher by Friday, October 9, 2026. Cash or a cheque payable to Danforth Park Public School is accepted. No student will be excluded for financial reasons - please speak with the office if the cost is a difficulty.

Students should bring a packed lunch and wear comfortable shoes.

PERMISSION FORM (please detach and return)
I give permission for my child, ____________________ (student name), in Class ______, to attend the Grade 4 trip to the Royal Ontario Museum on Thursday, October 15, 2026.
Emergency contact name: ____________________   Phone: ____________________
Parent/Guardian signature: ____________________   Date: ____________

Sincerely,
M. Osei, Principal
